title: Es dauert zwei Jahre
desc: The question everybody asks in the fourth month
setting: A Tuesday evening in January, four months in, and a question that has been waiting since November.

options.feedback: The truth, with a number. It is the only thing that helps and it does not sound like it.
True and empty. She has heard it three times this month.

options.es: Bei mir hat es auch gedauert.
options.en: It took a while with me too.
options.feedback: Better than most answers, and it stops one sentence short of being useful.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Alle sind freundlich. Aber ich war noch bei niemandem zu Hause.
steps.en: Everybody is friendly. But I have not been to anybody's home yet.

options.es: Das ist beides wahr. Das ist das Verwirrende.
options.en: Both of those are true. That is what is confusing.
options.feedback: Name the contradiction. She has been thinking she is imagining it.
A word that explains nothing and lets everybody off.

options.es: Du musst dich einfach mehr melden.
options.en: You just have to get in touch more.
options.feedback: It is also true and as the second sentence it lands as: this is your fault.

options.es: Und dann hört es nie mehr auf.
options.en: And then it never stops again.
options.feedback: The second half of the sentence, and it is the half that is worth having.
Honest and it leaves her holding two years and nothing else.

options.es: Vielleicht geht es bei dir schneller.
options.en: Maybe it will be faster for you.
options.feedback: You do not know that, and she will measure herself against it in June.
The one answer that actually works, and it is a thing she can do on Wednesday.
Also true, and it is what happened to you rather than what you did.
That is how the two years got to be two years.
